scope: Authored source and CPU validation only; default-off renderer optimization, no runtime or FPS acceptance

fixes.notes: Atomic fixed per-region words, release OR before release chunk/region stamps; generation acquired before note snapshot; no lazy pointer publication
fixes.region_generation: All actual source reads/writes use atomic_ref acquire/release
fixes.generation_wrap: A noted retained capture matching the current full-region generation is classified even when its chunk is lower
fixes.page_counts: Count absolute guest pages across clipped merged intervals

tests.fallback: No partial plan published before fallback

limits: No GPU/device/game run or image/output equivalence has been performed on this binary
Existing gen_now and chunk-lifetime synchronization assumptions remain renderer preconditions; this is not a general race-freedom proof
Concurrent note probe is not a thread-sanitizer proof
Dense regions can retain 512 note/chunk visits and extra cap checks; performance is unmeasured
Generation wrap retains old numeric-generation semantics rather than fixing the original renderer recycling policy
New and inherited pool paths, protection, GPU-page diagnostics and workload are preserved; only mirror_sync planning is changed
